rule: policy_weakening may act only on an operational policy explicitly marked waivable. Everything listed here is non-waivable and can be changed only by a new specification PR carrying a Founder decision — never by a runtime policy_weakening envelope.

non_waivable.subject: Codex independence — the reviewer is a principal distinct from the implementer

waivable_targets.requirement: A policy_weakening authorization is refused unless its target_identity resolves to a policy explicitly marked waivable in the policy document in force.
waivable_targets.default: Unmarked is non-waivable. Absence of a waivable marking is never permission (INV-A1).

amendment: Amending this list requires a new specification PR and a Founder decision reference. It cannot be amended at runtime.
